samples.query: 帮我做个卡片，看杭州市西湖区现在是什么天气，点一下查看杭州天气详情。

["root", "Layout", {"layout": "S-title-primary-secondary-action", "linearGradient": {"direction": "RightBottom", "colors": [["#FF8FC7E8", 0], ["#FFF3E3B8", 1]]}}, ["header", "current", "region", "cta"]]

samples.query: 帮我做个耳机状态卡片，分别看左右耳机电量，再看各自是否在充电。
周末准备去杭州露营，帮我做个卡片，分别看杭州明天和后天的天气、空气质量。
samples.dsl:
["root", "Layout", {"layout": "S-title-dual-content", "variant": "stacked-info", "linearGradient": {"direction": "RightBottom", "colors": [["#FF9BCFAE", 0], ["#FFDFEFB6", 1]]}}, ["header", "tomorrow", "after"]]

samples.query: 帮我做个天气卡片，看看成都和上海各多少度、什么天气，能直接在卡片上看到。
帮我做个运动卡片，今天目标是8000步，查看步数和目标完成情况，并展示热量消耗和距离。
samples.dsl:
["root", "Layout", {"layout": "S-title-dual-content", "linearGradient": {"direction": "RightBottom", "colors": [["#FFFBBBAE", 0], ["#FFF9E5B4", 1]]}}, ["header", "ring", "detail"]]
["header", "SingleLineTitle", {"title": "今日运动", "fontSize": 12}]
["ring", "ProgressCircleSingle", {"value": {"path": "/data/healthSport/dailySteps"}, "total": 8000, "icon": "resources/base/media/figure_run.svg", "displayValue": "{{ ${/data/healthSport/dailySteps} + '/8000' }}", "label": "步数", "color": "#FF1F4799", "backgroundColor": "#331F4799"}]
["detail", "SecondaryBody", {"items": [{"label": "热量 ", "value": {"path": "/data/healthSport/dailyTotalCaloriesText"}}, {"label": "距离 ", "value": {"path": "/data/healthSport/dailyDistanceText"}}], "columns": 1, "fontSize": 12}]
["/data/healthSport/dailySteps", 6200]
["/data/healthSport/dailyTotalCaloriesText", "420 千卡"]
["/data/healthSport/dailyDistanceText", "4.60 公里"]
